prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: painted dark-fantasy game animation atlas with true transparent background.
Edit the reference into one complete UNARMED full-body pose suite, generated together in ONE 4-column by 4-row atlas, exactly 16 isolated figures in reading order. Output a 2048x2048 transparent PNG. Each slot 512 square with generous transparent gutters, every figure wholly within its cell, no border, labels, lettering, scenery or floor shadows.
Reference image 1 is the approved Reaver identity/outfit: closed dark steel helmet with bronze trim, heavy weathered charcoal plate with fine old gold trim, deep burgundy cape and tabard, brown belts, plated boots and articulated gauntlets. Preserve same armor, build, proportions, materials and painterly rendering throughout. Image 2 is a padded canvas of the same identity only; replace its layout with the 4x4 suite.
CRITICAL CHANGE: REMOVE sword, shield, scabbard, staff and ALL weapons or held objects from EVERY pose. BOTH hands empty. The gauntlets are ordinary armor over anatomically correct human hands; clenched fists have thumbs outside curled fingers, no mitten stumps, no extra fingers/arms. Exactly two arms and two legs. No magical glow, aura, sparks, smoke, speed streaks, impact burst or particles anywhere, including Cast and Buff.
All full-body figures face screen RIGHT in consistent three-quarter side view, left foot forward and left hand leading, right hand rear; no mirroring. Consistent camera and body scale. Show boots fully. Feet baseline about 470px down each slot. Keep the same planted stance footprint through punches, plausible hip/shoulder rotation rather than translating the body across cell.
Reading order slots:
Row 1: (1) READY relaxed boxer guard, both fists near chest/chin. (2) ATK01 tighten guard, weight loaded rearward, left fist begins forward. (3) ATK02 left jab halfway extension, right fist guarding chin. (4) ATK03 left jab full horizontal extension toward screen right, rear right fist guarding.
Row 2: (5) ATK04 left fist retracts to guard while right shoulder coils. (6) ATK05 right straight cross at full extension toward screen right, left fist tightly guarding cheek, rear heel pivots. (7) ATK06 right fist halfway retracts as shoulders unwind. (8) ATK07 both fists recover into the original ready guard.
Row 3: (9) DEFEND compact high forearm guard, fists protecting helmet, elbows tucked, knees flexed. (10) HURT physically recoil chest backward, elbows lower slightly, feet stay grounded, no blood or effects. (11) CAST empty left palm extended forward with five readable fingers in a restrained channeling gesture, right hand open near chest, absolutely no magic visible. (12) BUFF physical centering breath with one closed fist pressed to breastplate and the other fist held near ribs, stable upright stance, no effects.
Row 4: (13) AGGRESSIVE STANCE deeper forward fighting lean, fists ready, intimidating physical posture. (14) DEFENSIVE STANCE low guarded stance with forearms covering torso and chin. (15) PORTRAIT close-up helmet and shoulders, identical closed helmet and burgundy cape, transparent cutout. (16) CONVERSATION full body calm upright pose, empty hands relaxed at sides, same screen-right facing.
Production sprite assets, richly detailed painted realism at small game scale; no concept-sheet captions or baked labels.
